verdict.rationale: An agent can pull payroll data programmatically. Payrolls are retrievable via GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls, the platform lists "Generate payroll reports", the official MCP server gives AI tools OAuth-scoped access to a company's own Gusto data, and the payroll.paid webhook signals when payroll credits are generated. Gusto also says it works with accounting apps. However, nothing documents journal-entry or general-ledger-formatted data, an export, or ledger reconciliation, so the agent would have to build the journal mapping itself. Missing for 10: a documented payroll journal/GL report endpoint or export, account-mapping and ledger-sync or reconciliation capability, and hands-on corroboration of an agent reconciling payroll into a ledger.
